recommendation.rationale: The highest-value first artifact is not an incident report but an independent routing response about whether a one-case preservation and formation-review pilot is intelligible. Eleos is closest to that ask on public-source fit; AIID is retained as secondary route-fit learning, and providers are later evidence holders rather than first independent reviewers.
what_to_send: the no-attachment reviewer-first body only after human signature, locator recheck, final hash recompute, and private custody roots exist
what_not_to_send: provider accusation or incident claim without concrete harm/near-harm

public_summary: rev0266 converts route preference into a ranked public-source due-diligence matrix. Eleos remains the recommended primary reviewer-first route, but the matrix authorizes nothing and requires send-time recheck.
